_comment: Running handoff doc 01 for Copilot to deploy and prove the W4 end-to-end SIT vertical slice after repo-side implementation/hardening is ready.
title: Deploy and verify W4 end-to-end SIT vertical slice with live proof
lane: Copilot - CI/CD process, deploy, live runtime verification, closeout proof
objective: Take the W4 end-to-end SIT vertical slice through the official Openclaw CI/CD process and return live proof that the product shell is usable or honestly deferred. Do not close on route health or marker parity alone; prove actual browser clicks, network/API behavior, persistence/deferred states, and runtime services.

procedures: Read the CI/CD README before starting.
Use Procedure E if batching multiple W4 fixes into one sprint deploy.
Use Procedure A for a single deployable code change.
Use Procedure C if live SIT behaves differently from repo/local proof.
non_negotiables: No direct VPS modifications. SSH is read-only diagnosis only.
All changes go through local edit -> Git commit -> push -> GitHub Actions deploy -> verify.
Deployment triggers and monitoring must target Piboonsak/Openclaw as the control plane.
Do not close without commit SHA, workflow run URL, automated health proof, and regression/live clickthrough proof.
Separate route health from user-flow success in the final report.

preconditions: Claude/Codex repo-side implementation has completed or explicitly marked the current handoff SHA as deploy-ready.
Read `docs/requirement/phaseII/epic-10/W4-SIT-E2E-CODEX-REVIEW-01.md` before deploy. If it says a Claude follow-up is still open, do not deploy-close yet.
If `docs/requirement/phaseII/epic-10/W4-SIT-E2E-CLAUDE-CODE-FOLLOWUP-02-COMPLETION.md` is missing, perform only pre-deploy diagnosis/readiness checks and do not claim W4 SIT closure.

`npm run verify:w4-html` must pass before deploy. If it fails because `index.html` parity is stale, repair/sync `src/frontend/index.html` with the accepted `src/frontend/main-ux-ui.html` surface before deploying.
what_to_do: 1. Read the Openclaw CI/CD README and follow the correct procedure in order. Do not skip procedure steps.
2. Confirm the deployable ref/SHA and what repo-side changes are included. Reconcile Claude completion, Codex review, and any Claude follow-up completion with the actual git diff.

3. Run or review required local/pre-deploy checks for the W4 E2E scope. At minimum confirm the HTML integrity/parity guard, real-click checks, and focused backend/API tests that are available. `npm run verify:w4-html` must pass before deploy.
4. Deploy through the Openclaw control-plane workflow only. Do not modify the VPS directly.
5. After deploy, verify runtime services and routes. Confirm backend health, DB/Redis/service availability as exposed by approved health checks/logs, and public route status.
6. Run a credentialed browser clickthrough on the live SIT surface. Do not stop at 200 OK.
7. Capture failed network requests, console errors, auth/session behavior, and API payload behavior for the W4 proof path.
8. Confirm that `/phase2/prototype` and `/index.html` do not contradict each other in the W4 proof path.
9. Return a closeout JSON report with workflow URL, deployed SHA, route/runtime proof, live clickthrough proof, residual issues, and whether W4 SIT is PASS or BLOCKED.
10. If anything fails, classify the failure as deploy/runtime/config/code/design and hand it back with exact evidence. Do not call the task done.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Login/session
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Can enter the SIT review surface with the intended credential/session state; auth failures are understood and documented.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Dashboard
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Dashboard loads without blocker-level console/network errors and does not misrepresent shell-only data as final if deferred.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Companies
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Add/Edit Company persists and survives refresh/re-login, or the UI is visibly disabled/deferred with no fake-success toast.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Company settings COA/AP/AR
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: COA/AP/AR/settings surfaces are separate and honest; import/add controls are real or visibly deferred.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Users
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Add/Edit User persists and survives refresh/re-login, or the UI is visibly disabled/deferred with no fake-success toast.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Templates / Configurator
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Configurator tabs/actions click without ReferenceError; save/update/preview behavior is real or deferred clearly.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Export
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Quick Export preview/download call backend with template_id null; Template Export sends runtime column_overrides.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Upload/Processing/Review
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Visible controls either load real/fixture-labeled data or are visibly deferred; no fake success.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Future/internal surfaces
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Internal Console, Cost Control, Audit Log, Settings, Epic 14/15/16-looking controls are wired, role-guarded, hidden, or deferred.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Route parity
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: `/phase2/prototype` and `/index.html` do not present contradictory W4 UX or stale broken content.

runtime_checks: Public route status for `/phase2/prototype` and `/index.html` with auth behavior noted.
Backend health endpoint status using approved GET checks.
Container/service status or logs only through read-only diagnosis if needed.
API calls observed during live clickthrough for Company/User/Template/Export paths.
Browser console errors and failed network requests.
acceptance_criteria: Openclaw deploy workflow completed for the intended ref/SHA.
Workflow run URL and deployed SHA are recorded.
Automated health checks pass or any failure is explicitly classified and blocking.
Live browser clickthrough covers the full W4 product-shell proof path.
Company/User actions are proven persisted or visibly deferred on live SIT.
No visible W4 proof-path action shows success without backend success.
Export/Configurator live behavior remains correct after deploy.
`/phase2/prototype` and `/index.html` do not contradict the accepted W4 surface.
Final report clearly says PASS or BLOCKED with evidence.
blocked_exit_conditions: Backend services or DB/Redis dependencies are down for the proof path.
Company/User still show fake-success behavior on live SIT.
Export/Configurator regresses from the accepted W4 backend wiring.
The deployed SHA does not include the intended repo-side fixes.
Workflow passes but browser clickthrough fails.
final_instruction_to_copilot: Take this through the official Openclaw CI/CD procedure and prove live SIT behavior. Do not claim W4 SIT closure from route 200, marker parity, or local-only proof. Close only with browser-level evidence and deployed-runtime proof.
